header.headline: Qualitative and architecture records — no invented numbers
header.subhead: KONSENXIA publishes no lab numbers yet. Entries here are architecture or roadmap statements with source, date, and status attached.

metrics.label: Planned interface language set
metrics.methodology: Declared product scope from repository planning documentation; not a shipped-languages count.
metrics.notes: Planned set. Turkish and English availability order to be confirmed at implementation.

metrics.label: Compliance posture
metrics.methodology: Requirements and principles recorded in legal documentation and mapped to architecture decisions; no external certification asserted.
metrics.notes: Design goals, not certificates. HIPAA-aligned handling is a target posture for qualifying deployments.

metrics.label: Anonymity pipeline
metrics.methodology: Pipeline architecture separates direct identifiers from learning signals by design; no audit or certification performed to date.
metrics.notes: "Designed for" — not "certified". Any future certification will be published with auditor, scope, and date.

metrics.label: Defined feature modules
metrics.methodology: Enumeration of modules specified in the architecture document: AI medical consultation, doctor-to-doctor, anonymized learning, differential diagnosis, emergency consult, knowledge hub, drug analytics, medical files.
metrics.notes: Defined ≠ shipped. Per-module delivery status is tracked as architecture or roadmap on the platform page.

metrics.label: Expert review theme set
metrics.methodology: Themes captured from FAZ_C expert review sessions and carried into the roadmap as safety, explainability, and auditability work items.
metrics.notes: Themes inform prioritisation; they are not measurable outcomes.

metrics.label: Clinical performance metrics
metrics.methodology: No lab measurement published yet. Will require defined cohort, endpoint, and environment before any figure appears here.
metrics.notes: Placeholder status record. Publishing a number without methodology + source + date is forbidden by METRICS_POLICY.md.

investorNarrative.note: Narrative only. No figures beyond the registry above; anything unmeasured is described qualitatively.
investorNarrative.problem: Clinical decisions still rely on fragmented references and ad-hoc peer consultation, while institutions hesitate to adopt AI whose data path they cannot inspect. The market needs assistance that is clinically useful and legally legible at the same time.
investorNarrative.wedge: Clinic- and hospital-level deployments where clinician collaboration and a designed anonymization pipeline answer procurement's first question: where does patient data go? KVKK + GDPR design goals open Turkish and EU conversations before any certification round.
investorNarrative.moat: Architecture and legal documentation treated as product artifacts: healthcare_ai_architecture.md, docs/legal/*, and expert-review themes form a coherent, auditable design record. Clinician-in-the-loop workflows earn the trust that pure automation struggles to obtain in clinical settings.
investorNarrative.license: Landing site and public components are dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0 (see /open-source). The clinical application, models, and datasets remain proprietary and are licensed under agreement.
investorNarrative.community: The open landing repository is the public surface: locales, documentation, accessibility, and design contributions are reviewed in the open. Star the repo if it helps; watch for releases; open an issue or ship a branch — we review.

disclaimer: All entries are architecture or roadmap statements sourced from repository documentation as of 2026-06. Nothing on this page is a clinical performance claim, a certification, or a regulatory clearance.
